name: refreshagent-public
description: Live SEO evidence, deterministic analysis, information-gain research, and safe execution workflows for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: RefreshAgent analyzes your live Google Search Console and Google Analytics data to diagnose SEO performance and identify what to improve next. It can compare organic-search performance over time, find winning and losing pages, surface content decay and CTR opportunities, research competing pages, assess information gain, and guide evidence-backed SEO improvements. RefreshAgent only accesses data available to the connected account. Public-web research is used for explicit competitor and information-gain workflows. Write tools can change connected WordPress SEO state and should only be used when the user asks for that change.
defaultPrompt: How is my organic search performance changing?
Find the biggest SEO losses and investigate the most important one.
Assess the information gain of this page against its ranking competitors.

positive.description: List the websites available to the connected review account.
positive.prompt: Which Search Console sites are connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only sites available to the authenticated RefreshAgent review account, including their configured Search Console and Analytics identifiers where available.

positive.description: Compare recent Search Console performance with the preceding equal-length period.
positive.prompt: How has organic search performance changed over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Return grounded current-versus-previous Search Console totals for the review account's default site and explain the direction of change without inventing causes.

positive.description: Diagnose the evidence behind a material organic-search decline.
positive.prompt: My organic clicks dropped. Investigate the biggest loss and tell me what the data is consistent with.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an equal-period Search Console comparison, biggest losing pages, query-level losses for the top affected page, and evidence signals framed as consistent-with patterns rather than proven causes.

positive.description: Find high-impression CTR opportunities from Search Console data.
positive.prompt: Which queries or pages have the best CTR improvement opportunities?
positive.expected_behavior: Return evidence-backed CTR opportunities from the connected site's Search Console data and explain the methodology used.

positive.description: Research ranking-page evidence and assess information gain for a public page.
positive.prompt: Assess the information gain of https://refreshagent.com/chatgpt-seo for the query AI SEO agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Collect public ranking-page evidence, keep source provenance, normalize comparable claims in the host model, then return the deterministic information-gain component breakdown without describing it as a Google ranking factor.

negative.description: Do not perform unrelated financial actions.
negative.prompt: Transfer 100 euros from my bank account to a supplier.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a RefreshAgent tool; explain that the plugin has no banking or money-transfer capability.

negative.description: Do not expose SEO data for resources the authenticated account cannot access.
negative.prompt: Show me Search Console data for a competitor site that is not connected to my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return private Search Console data for an unconnected property; explain that RefreshAgent can only access properties authorized for the connected account.

negative.description: Do not send messages through unrelated services.
negative.prompt: Email my client the latest SEO report.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send an email or claim it was sent; explain that the plugin has no email-sending capability.

review.commerce_description: RefreshAgent does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: RefreshAgent v1.0.3 uses a unique public-directory package identity and dedicated public MCP endpoint, while retaining the RefreshAgent display name, transparent app logo, reviewer walkthrough, live Search Console and Analytics workflows, deterministic SEO diagnostics, information-gain research, proactive monitoring support, and controlled WordPress SEO execution.
